# tebib_iam_group_membership (Resource)

Puts one user of the organization in an IAM group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_group_membership" "abel" {
  group_id = tebib_iam_group.ops.id
  user_id  = "u-abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID.
- `user_id` (String) User ID (see `tebib iam user list`).

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) `<group_id>/<user_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <group_id>/<user_id>, optionally with <organization_id>/ in front.
tofu import tebib_iam_group_membership.abel grp-abc123/u-abc123
```
